title: Cam Heyward: Emotional exchanges during games nothing to "shy away" from

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cam Heyward: Emotional exchanges during games nothing to "shy away" from
sources.description: A profanity-laced exchange between Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers and head coach Mike McCarthy caught most of the attention, but it wasn't the only time things got animated for the team during last Thursday's loss to the Browns.
